name: ZALO-02 | Nờ Lập Phương Text Alerts

parameters.content:
ZALO-01 — NỜ LẬP PHƯƠNG

Only plain-text messages from Nờ Lập Phương enter this workflow. Other senders, images, and files are suppressed by the read-only bridge. Accepted messages are deduplicated and immediately reported to Telegram.

SAFETY BOUNDARY

Read-only monitoring. Never auto-react, vote, approve, agree, spend money, or send a Zalo reply. Incoming Zalo images and files are ignored. Telegram remains text-only until a compact custom icon is ready; Gemini is not used by this rule.
